sourceMaterials.name: Condition Summary
sourceMaterials.verification: search-index transcription, not checked against official edition document

copyrightBoundary: Record only original paraphrases and mechanics in native data. Any imported 3.x SRD passage must retain appropriate OGL/provenance records distinct from the CC BY 5.x source archive.

decisions.rationale: Keep restriction on actions but no AC penalty. Do not simply inherit native Incapacitated because that would automatically end Concentration, which is not a source Dazed consequence.

Adopt expanded 3.5 scope: -1 attacks plus Search and Spot; 3.0 specified -1 attacks alone. Keep Search/Spot as canonical native skill identities without imposing duplicate penalty on parent Perception.

Both editions halve unanchored movement, prohibit run/charge and penalize attack -2/effective Dexterity -4; anchored bonds set movement zero. 3.0 spell check typically DC 15, 3.5 specifies DC 15 plus spell level; record newer formula as candidate while preventing accidental application to 5.x Concentration saves.
deferred: cross-edition effective Dexterity score vs dexterity modifier ordering and cap semantics

decisions.rationale: 3.5 defines the attentive, stationary state, -4 to reactive perception checks, renewed save when potential threats appear, obvious-threat ending, and standard-action ally intervention.

Both versions prevent offensive/casting/concentration or attentive activities while allowing a move/move-equivalent activity. The full 3.x move action does not equal just movement distance in native 5.x, so no executable action conversion is asserted.
deferred: mapping one 3.x move-equivalent activity onto Action/Bonus Action and movement budgets

decisions.rationale: Apply -2 to attacks, weapon damage, saving throws, skill checks and ability checks. Remains distinct from Poisoned or Nauseated; do not convert numeric -2 automatically to Disadvantage.

pendingReclassification: Dying, Stable, Disabled, Dead, Ability Damage, Ability Drain, Energy Drain, Incorporeal
environmental displacement (Blown Away, Checked, Knocked Down)
rulesBoundary: All six definitions are adopted as native data; Entangled and Nauseated include explicitly deferred integration fields, not working runtime effects.
